onSuccess.description: Callback when an address operation completes successfully. Use to refresh the list, show notifications, or trigger navigation.

onError.description: Callback when an address operation fails. Use to display custom error messages, log errors, or trigger recovery flows.

onSubmit.description: Callback when the user submits an address form. Use to validate before submission, add custom fields, or trigger analytics.

onAddressData.description: Callback when address data is loaded or changed. Use to prefill forms, sync with external systems, or validate address data.

Addresses.description: The `Addresses` container is a standalone component that creates, edits, and deletes customer addresses. It supports custom address attributes and configurable validation through the Adobe Commerce Admin.

onSubmit.description: Callback when the user submits the address form. Use to validate before submission, add custom fields, or trigger analytics.

onCloseBtnClick.description: Callback when the user clicks the close button. Use to confirm unsaved changes, trigger navigation, or clean up state.

onSuccess.description: Callback when the address form submission completes successfully. Use to close the form, refresh data, or show notifications.

onError.description: Callback when the address form submission fails. Use to display custom error messages, log errors, or trigger recovery flows.

onChange.description: Callback when form field values change. Use for real-time validation, auto-save drafts, or syncing with external systems.

AddressForm.description: The `AddressForm` container creates and edits customer addresses. Merchants build a custom user experience around address management with a pre-built form that minimizes development effort. The form integrates with the Adobe Commerce backend, providing flexible configuration of address attributes, validation, labels, and attribute sorting.

AddressValidation.description: The `AddressValidation` container displays a suggested shipping address (from a third-party verification service) alongside the entered address, allowing shoppers to choose between them.

CustomerInformation.description: The `CustomerInformation` container is a standalone component that provides customers with access to their personal information. It allows users to view and edit their profile details, including their name, contact information, password, and email address.

OrdersList.description: The `OrdersList` container is a standalone component designed to provide access to a customer's order history and detailed order information. It can be rendered in a full-size or minified view.
